articles.title: Circle raises $222 million for Arc, beats Q1 earnings estimates but misses on revenue
articles.snippet: Circle raised $222 million for its Arc blockchain token at a $3 billion valuation, drawing backing from BlackRock, Apollo and Bullish.

articles.title: Bitcoin whipsaws on CME open as Iran tensions pressure crypto markets
articles.snippet: BTC briefly topped $82,400 before slipping below $81,000 as traders repositioned around CME futures open and geopolitical risks rattled markets.

articles.title: Policy at Consensus Miami: State of Crypto
Bank of England chief says global stablecoin rules will ‘wrestle’ with US
articles.snippet: Global regulators will have to confront US policy on dollar-backed stablecoins as they seek international standards for payment tokens, Andrew Bailey said.

articles.title: Australian Police Seize Millions in Bitcoin From Alleged Darknet Marketplace Operator
articles.snippet: Two men face money laundering and drug charges following the seizure of $4.2 million in Bitcoin from alleged darknet marketplace dealings.
